name: Jack Nicholson The Shining Snow
look: A film still of Jack Nicholson as Jack Torrance from The Shining, frozen solid and half buried in snow beside snow-covered hedges. Frost coats his hair, eyebrows and face, his eyes roll upward and his mouth hangs slightly open.
use: Stands for being frozen to the bone or stuck waiting out in the cold. Captions describe freezing weather, an icy office, a cold shower or waiting outside far too long.
examples: Me waiting for the bus in January
The app said 2 minutes, 40 minutes ago
Me after my roommate set the thermostat to 60
describe: man frozen stiff at the end of a kubrick horror movie
man frozen solid with frost all over his face
guy covered in snow and ice staring upward
the shining ending frozen outside the hedge maze
freezing cold man iced over in winter
origin: Jack Nicholson as Jack Torrance frozen in the snow near the end of Stanley Kubrick's The Shining (1980).
